metadata.title: Using the slide viewer
metadata.summary: A two-minute tour of moving around a whole-slide image: zoom, pan, fit and the overview. Nothing here is scored.
objectives: Zoom, pan and fit a whole-slide image with the keyboard or a pointer.

review.notes: Interface instructions only; no clinical teaching text.

steps.title: How this viewer works
steps.text: This short tour shows how to move around a slide. Nothing here is scored; {cmd:step:next} moves to the next step.

steps.title: Zoom and pan
steps.text: Zoom with {cmd:zoomin} and {cmd:zoomout}, the mouse wheel or a pinch; pan with the arrow keys or by dragging. {cmd:fit} shows the whole slide again.

steps.title: Magnification is derived
steps.text: The readout in the corner is derived from micrometres per screen pixel: 20× means 0.50 µm per pixel. The overview, {cmd:nav}, shows where you are on the slide.

steps.title: Ready
steps.text: That is all you need for the case modules.
